en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard depicting a busy central square with market stalls, umbrellas, and people walking. Historic multi‑story buildings with shop signs line the square, and a statue stands on a pedestal in the middle. In the background, on a hill, a prominent clock tower rises above the town. The bottom margin of the card is printed with German text including the place name.
